parameters.content:
## Weekly FDA Class I Recall Radar
1. Set `APIFY_TOKEN` in your n8n environment variables (or replace `{{ $env.APIFY_TOKEN }}` in the HTTP node with your Bearer token).
2. Swap the final **Connect Slack / Email / Webhook Here** node for Slack, Gmail, or Microsoft Teams.
3. Uses the exact same pattern to query any of our other 7 US Government Actors (e.g. `sec-edgar-filings-mcp` or `usaspending-federal-contracts-mcp`).
